I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **November 3, 2025**.

- **Source:** Moss's Coastal digest from Nov 2, 2025 says "Account ownership changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." Bettina's own Dec 8 recap note gives the same official handoff date.
- **Day-to-day date:** The recap also says Bettina kept running the account until Nov 21, and Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 3 for the official handoff and Nov 22 for when Kwame took over day to day.
- **PHL mix-up:** "PHL" is also shorthand for Covey & Lark Retail, now Pellow Home Living. I flagged that the Nov 2 digest is the Pellucid one.
